CASE STUDY 01 · MEDICARE

Healthcare access,
made clearer.

MediCare explores a simpler online medical-delivery journey while bringing together medicine discovery, prescription upload, checkout, delivery support and safety-focused features in one mobile experience.

PROJECT OVERVIEW

From opening the app to getting care essentials home.

A walkthrough of the actual MediCare screens designed in Figma, presented in real-size phone mockups and ordered the way a user would meet them — from first launch to delivery and emergency support.

5FLOWS
2LANGUAGES

THE USER JOURNEY

01Welcome & account02Discover & prescription03Cart to checkout04After the order05Safety net

CHAPTER 01 · WELCOME & ACCOUNT

Onboarding that respects first-time users

7 SCREENS

A short, skippable introduction: brand, language, the three promises of the app, then a simple sign-up and OTP verification.

SCREEN 01

Splash Screen

Brand introduction with the “Your health our priority” tagline and a friendly care-team illustration.

SCREEN 02

Choose Language

English and Tamil are offered first, so the whole experience feels familiar from the very first tap.

SCREEN 03

Fast & Secure Payments

Introduces UPI, card and flexible EMI options to build trust before the first order.

SCREEN 04

Personalized Pill Reminders

Smart dose reminders and low-supply alerts so users never miss a day.

SCREEN 05

Rapid & Tracked Delivery

Sets the expectation of real-time tracking from pharmacy to doorstep.

SCREEN 06

Sign Up

Clear field grouping, show/hide password, consent text and a visible log-in path.

SCREEN 07

OTP Verification

Four-digit code entry with an active-box highlight and a Resend option.

CHAPTER 02 · DISCOVER & PRESCRIPTION

Find the right medicine, prove the prescription

3 SCREENS

From a warm welcome and category shortcuts to product details and a guided prescription upload.

SCREEN 08

Home

Personal greeting, search, cart badge, offer banner, categories and bestsellers with a persistent bottom navigation.

↕ SCROLLS INSIDE THE PHONE
SCREEN 09

Product Details

Pricing and discount, expandable description, similar and offer products, with a fixed Add to Cart action.

↕ SCROLLS INSIDE THE PHONE
SCREEN 10

Upload Prescription

Gallery or camera options plus clear guidelines: readable details, formats, 10MB limit and recent date.

CHAPTER 03 · CART TO CHECKOUT

Fewer decisions, clearer next step

5 SCREENS

Quantity control, saved addresses, a focused new-address form and payment grouped by type.

SCREEN 11

My Cart

Product thumbnails, quantity steppers, remove actions and a sticky Proceed to Checkout button.

SCREEN 12

Delivery Address

Saved Office and Home addresses, a custom address card and an obvious add-new option.

SCREEN 13

New Address

Contact info and address info are separated into two calm groups before Save.

SCREEN 14

Payment Methods

Total bill with the discount shown, then UPI, cards and cash on delivery grouped by type.

SCREEN 15

Card Payment

Focused card form with expiry and CVV side by side, Add new Card and a save-information option.

CHAPTER 04 · AFTER THE ORDER

Confirmation and peace of mind

2 SCREENS

A clear success moment followed by a timeline that explains exactly what happens next.

SCREEN 16

Order Successful

Large confirmation, short reassurance message and one obvious action: Track Order.

SCREEN 17

Track My Order

A four-step timeline — payment confirmed, being prepared, on the way, arrived.

CHAPTER 05 · SAFETY NET

Help when it matters most

1 SCREEN

A dedicated emergency experience that keeps the important action and reassurance visible.

SCREEN 18

Emergency SOS

Hold-to-send SOS button, cancel option, shared-location state, emergency contacts and a one-tap ambulance call (108).

DESIGN NOTE

Every screen shown here is the original Figma design. Screens that did not match the phone’s proportions were never cropped or stretched — they were extended at the edges with their own background colour — and long screens like Home and Product Details scroll inside the frame, just like on a real device.

“The interface should help the user understand what to do next — especially when the situation is urgent.”

CASE STUDY 02 · PAUSESCREEN

A pause between
impulse and action.

PauseScreen is a digital-wellbeing concept that does not simply block an app. Instead, it creates a short intervention and offers useful alternatives when the user wants to step away.

The problem

Opening an app can become an automatic habit. A simple pause can make the user aware of how much time has already passed.

The intervention

Show time awareness, ask whether the user has a purpose, and create a clear moment to choose what happens next.

The intention

Make the experience supportive rather than punitive — a gentle nudge toward intentional use.

PROJECT OVERVIEW

From automatic scrolling to a conscious choice.

A walkthrough of the actual PauseScreen designs from Figma, shown in real-size phone mockups in the order a user meets them — from choosing which apps to pause, to the check-in moment, to healthier alternatives and progress.

Set upTriggerReflectChooseRedirectCelebrateTrack
13SCREENS
4FLOWS
5MIN RESET

THE USER JOURNEY

01Set up02The pause moment03Redirect04Progress

CHAPTER 01 · SET UP

Set up in under a minute

4 SCREENS

Choose the apps that distract you most and decide when the pause should appear — everytime, or only during focus hours.

SCREEN 01

Splash Screen

Two bold pause bars on pure black introduce the brand with zero clutter.

SCREEN 02

Choose Apps to Pause

A friendly grid of app tiles with a clear selected state — Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and more.

↕ SCROLLS INSIDE THE PHONE
SCREEN 03

When Should We Pause You?

Two large options: Everytime, or Focus hours with a custom time range.

SCREEN 04

You’re All Set

Confirmation that sets the expectation: a moment to check in the next time a paused app opens.

CHAPTER 02 · THE PAUSE MOMENT

A check-in, not a block

3 SCREENS

When a paused app opens, PauseScreen asks — kindly — whether the user still wants to continue and why.

SCREEN 05

The Trigger

The user opens a paused app such as Instagram. This is the moment the intervention appears.

SCREEN 06

Do You Still Want to Open?

Two equal choices — continue, or do something else — so the decision stays with the user.

SCREEN 07

Why Are You Opening?

A quick self check-in: I’m bored, it’s habit, or I need something.

CHAPTER 03 · REDIRECT

Offer something better to do

3 SCREENS

If the user chooses to do something else, the app suggests small, useful activities and gently celebrates the choice.

SCREEN 08

Use 5 Minutes Differently

Study, get some water, take a short walk or take a breath — with an easy “I’m done for now” exit.

SCREEN 09

Focus Timer

A calm countdown ring keeps the small activity simple and time-boxed.

SCREEN 10

Nice Pause!

Positive reinforcement that celebrates the choice instead of shaming the habit.

CHAPTER 04 · PROGRESS

See the small wins add up

3 SCREENS

A personal dashboard, weekly stats and settings help users understand and tune their habits over time.

SCREEN 11

Home Dashboard

Daily pause progress toward a goal, an attention snapshot and quick choices to act on.

SCREEN 12

Your Stats

Weekly range, best streak, charts and the top apps the user paused from.

SCREEN 13

Settings

Notifications, apps to pause, pause settings, focus mode and account support in one place.

DESIGN NOTE

Every screen shown is the original Figma design. Screens that were slightly taller than the phone were fitted to the frame and extended on the sides with their own black background, and the long app-selection screen scrolls inside the phone like on a real device.
